stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Fig 1 to Fig 12, all by hand?
stations.note: She numbers a batch on paper.

stations.title: Workbench
stations.text: Labels, counts and prices, done in a blink.

captions: The rules are functions now. Today Ines has jobs that repeat the same small step.
She numbers a batch, counts weeks and counts letters by hand, and loses her place.
You write each repeated step once with for, while and for...of, in four tasks.
Now the whole batch is numbered and the engraving priced in one run.
Loops repeat a step for you, and stop when the job is done.
